test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

It was difficult for her to __salvage__ her reputation after the scam.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Damage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salvage **means to rescue or save something, especially from damage or destruction. (किसी चीज़ को बचाना या बचाना, विशेषकर क्षति या विनाश से)

 
 
• **Example**: *After the flood, the volunteers worked tirelessly to salvage belongings from the damaged houses.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Damage **means to harm or spoil something. (किसी चीज़ को हानि पहुँचाना या बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The storm's strong winds and heavy rain caused significant damage to the crops.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the person's reputation was negatively affected by the scam, so the correct antonym is "damage".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Claim**: To demand or take as rightful or legal. (उचित या वैध मान कर माँग करना या लेना)
 
• **Recover**: To regain or get back something lost or taken. (कोई खोई हुई या छीनी हुई वस्तु पुनः प्राप्त करना या प्राप्त करना)
 
• **Rescue**: To save someone or something from a dangerous or difficult situation. (किसी खतरनाक या कठिन परिस्थिति से किसी को या वस्तु को बचाना)
